seq_set_path.note: seq_set_path X Y p: p is a nonempty vertex sequence whose first entry is in X and last entry in Y, without repeated entries, with consecutive entries adjacent. The empty sequence is never a path; [:: x] is one exactly when x \in X :&: Y; empty endpoint sets admit none; no disjointness of X and Y, distinct-endpoint, length or internal-avoidance premise; on a tail it is upstream upath after splitting off the head, and irredundant packaged paths give one.
